summary: Backend and Expo web smoke/regression testing completed: 5/6 API tests passed; mobile Home, Categories, Profile navigation and Admin entry rendered successfully.

critical.issue: Returns HTTP 500 after inserting the category because the response includes MongoDB ObjectId; FastAPI cannot JSON serialize it.

integration_issues.issue: UI request reaches the API but fails with 500, so category creation cannot complete.

action_items: Fix POST /api/admin/categories to exclude _id or return a cleaned document after insert; retest admin quick add and persistence.
Verify frontend API base URL consistently uses the required EXPO_BACKEND_URL environment variable rather than relying only on app.json backendUrl fallback.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py add_category returns the inserted Mongo document without removing _id, causing the observed 500.
frontend/app/index.tsx builds API from Constants.expoConfig.extra.backendUrl or EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL; EXPO_BACKEND_URL is not read directly as required by the environment contract.
Admin login inputs and several controls lack testID attributes, reducing automated coverage.
seed_data_creation: Created and attempted cleanup of TEST_regression_category; insert succeeded before response serialization failed, so a TEST_regression_category record may remain and should be cleaned by the developer.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public health, categories, wallpapers, daily darshan, search, admin JWT/dashboard, and unauthenticated rejection passed. Mobile viewport loaded Home and navigated Categories/Profile; Admin entry was visible. Browser error check itself had a selector quoting syntax error, not an app error.
rca_of_issue: POST /api/admin/categories calls insert_one(item) then returns item. Motor mutates item with _id:ObjectId. Unlike list endpoints, this response is not passed through clean(), producing FastAPI jsonable_encoder ObjectId errors and HTTP 500 after persistence.
